negative_controls: Every valid variable-rate step must contract
Same residual and protected value determine one exact point
Small residual forces a small total state movement
Zero sampled alternating profile means zero full profile
Exact first sixteen coordinates imply exact infinite candidate
Two zero-cost free edges compose to the identity path
Associative phase must be a symmetric coboundary
scope: Finite exact arithmetic regression. Infinite convergence, closure, nonexistence and norm claims rely on the supplied mathematical proofs, not finite extrapolation. No Lean replay is executed.
